title: Analyze and Monitor Telemetry with Power BI
summary: Power BI apps for analyzing Business Central telemetry provide four reports (Usage, Errors, Performance, Administration) to monitor environment and app performance, troubleshoot issues, and track changes. Use these free open-source apps to investigate usage patterns, system errors, performance bottlenecks, and administrative changes in Business Central.
features: Usage report with sessions, clients, locations, page views, reports, feature usage, integrations, and deprecated features tracking
Error report covering user errors, integration errors, and system errors
Performance report with session timings, page views, reports, long-running SQL queries, database lock timeouts, and job queue timings
Administration report showing environment inventory, update planning, and change tracking for environments, companies, extensions, indexes, and fields
KQL query access for deeper analysis
